sources.title: [2602.11151] Diffusion-Pretrained Dense and Contextual Embeddings
sources.snippet: In this report, we introduce pplx-embed, a family of multilingual embedding models that employ multi-stage contrastive learning on a diffusion-pretrained language model backbone for web-scale retrieval. sources.title: llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2 Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2 was developed by NVIDIA as part of the Nemotron retriever family. In addition to enabling multilingual and cross-lingual retrieval, this model reduces data storage footprint through dynamic embedding sizing and support for longer token length, making it feasible to handle large-scale datasets efficiently.
